en.headline: Man dies after collapsing while repairing pipe at Ma On Shan flat
en.dek: A man in his sixties was certified dead at Prince of Wales Hospital after his daughter found him unconscious in the bathroom of their Kam Ying Court home.
body: Police said a woman reported shortly before 9pm on Monday that her father, in his sixties, had collapsed while repairing a water pipe in the bathroom of their flat at Kam Dat House, Kam Ying Court, in Ma On Shan.

Emergency responders found the man unconscious and took him to Prince of Wales Hospital, where he was certified dead at 10.03pm. The case is being handled as a collapse pending further enquiries, including whether he was struck by a pipe or fitting or suffered a sudden medical episode.

According to information from the scene, the building had recently experienced a saltwater pipe burst that interrupted flushing water supply, which was restored earlier on Monday. The flat was reportedly flooded at one point, and the man is believed to have been attempting a home repair when he collapsed.

zh.headline: 馬鞍山錦英苑男子修水管時暈倒 送院不治
zh.dek: 六旬男子於錦英苑錦達閣家中廁所維修水管時突然暈倒，女兒報案，送威爾斯親王醫院搶救至晚上10時03分證實不治。
body: 警方表示，周一晚上近9時，一名女子報案指其年約60餘歲父親在馬鞍山錦英苑錦達閣家中廁所維修水管時突然暈倒，報案人懷疑父親遭水管或零件打中。
救援人員到場發現男事主仍然昏迷，將他送往威爾斯親王醫院搶救，惟至晚上10時03分證實不治。警方正調查事件起因，包括事主是否曾被物件擊中，抑或突然暈倒，案件暫列作「有人暈倒」跟進。
現場消息指，錦達閣近日有鹹水管爆裂，沖廁水一度暫停供應，至周一才恢復。事主疑在家中維修水管時暈倒，其住所亦一度水浸。
